introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes!
Some people are always on time bu

vocabulary.definition: the quality of being on time or prompt
vocabulary.example: His punctuality at work impressed his boss.

vocabulary.definition: the practice of arriving or completing tasks on time
vocabulary.example: Her excellent timekeeping skills ensure she never misses a deadline.

vocabulary.definition: the act of opposing or withstanding something
vocabulary.example: Despite the resistance from the team, the project manager implemented the new policy.

vocabulary.definition: easily seen or noticed; attracting attention
vocabulary.example: Her bright red coat made her quite conspicuous in the crowd.

vocabulary.definition: causing discomfort or embarrassment; not smooth or graceful
vocabulary.example: There was an awkward silence after his unexpected comment.

vocabulary.definition: a time or date by which something must be finished or completed
vocabulary.example: The deadline for submitting the project proposal is next Friday.
